h1.en: CPVC Pipes does not retitle the Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 cells

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80. The row to open is /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Pressure mark PN10/16. Standard mark EN14420-3. Nominal size DN80 / 3″ / 89. Put /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 in the subject. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. The section title “PVC Pipes” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是DN80混凝土泵管卡输送量与输送距离询盘的数字。要打开的行是 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。压力铸印 PN10/16.标准铸印 EN14420-3.公称尺寸 DN80 / 3″ / 89.主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 开始。河北品锦机械在邢台把DN80混凝土泵管卡列在 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80。节标题「PVC 管道」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: For Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80, the heading “PVC Pipes” does not replace a cell. Pressure mark PN10/16. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80.

body.en: Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 is unchanged by the heading “CPVC Pipes”. Standard mark EN14420-3. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80.

body.en: Under “PP Pipes”, Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 contributes only the printed cells in this part. Put /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 in the subject. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-temperature-support-spacing-d_1205.html.

question.en: Does “PVC Pipes” replace Pressure mark PN10/16?
question.zh: 「PVC 管道」会替换「压力铸印 PN10/16」吗？

answer.en: No. Pressure mark PN10/16 remains the printed wording for Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80.
answer.zh: 不会。压力铸印 PN10/16仍是DN80混凝土泵管卡输送量与输送距离询盘已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Standard mark EN14420-3 belong on the Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80 row?
question.zh: DN80混凝土泵管卡输送量与输送距离询盘这一行里，「标准铸印 EN14420-3」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “CPVC Pipes” add to Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp DN80?
question.zh: 「CPVC 管道」给DN80混凝土泵管卡输送量与输送距离询盘增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-temperature-support-spacing-d_1205.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/plastic-pipes-temperature-support-spacing-d_1205.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
